_readme: Switchable QR codes. This file is the single source of truth.
Each key below becomes a printed QR code at /go/<key>. To repoint a code,
change its URL here and push — the build regenerates the redirect page and
every copy already printed goes somewhere new within about ten seconds.
NEVER rename or delete a key once its code has been printed or shared.
The key is the part that is physically on the paper; the URL is the part
you are free to change. Renaming a key kills every code carrying it.
Keys must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens — they become URL path
segments. Values must be full http or https addresses. The build fails on
anything else rather than shipping a broken redirect.
Edit this file through /switch, which validates as you type, or by hand.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
